items.headline_note: The search index shows the full headline as '...שנקבעה רק בינואר'.

body_fetch.blocker: paywall (.premium); only the lede and sub-headline were visible
body_fetch.visible_excerpt_summary: Options worth a combined ~NIS 10M for chairman Tomer Raved and CEO Nir David, above the policy approved at the shareholders' meeting early this year. Raved's options are worth ~NIS 4M, ~NIS 1M above the 2027 cap. Each may get up to ~NIS 3M more if the Bezeq-yes structural separation is cancelled. Shareholders vote next month.

primary_sources.name: Bezeq notice of special general meeting (Dec 21, 2026) and private-placement report for options to the chairman and CEO, published Friday Nov 13, 2026
primary_sources.note: All three outlets cite this filing, but it is not indexed and Bezeq IR, Maya and Magna all returned 403. Per those reports, the board itself calls the chairman's grant a 'one-time deviation' (חריגה נקודתית) of about NIS 1M from the equity-compensation cap.

primary_sources.name: Supplementary immediate report, special general meeting of Jan 25, 2026 (revised compensation policy, 3-year term)
verified_terms: Revised policy runs for 3 years from approval by the general meeting (Jan 2026)
Section 7.3.1: cap of NIS 5.7M per year on the performance-based grant plus the equity-based grant of the Chairman and the CEO; the wording leaves open whether the cap is per officer or combined
Section 9.2.5: the chairman's equity-compensation ceiling at grant was updated; the new figure is in Appendix A, which was not reachable

One-time bonus for chairman and relevant CEOs if the structural separation is cancelled, subject to three conditions (regulator decision, legal merger of yes into Bezeq, recognition of a deferred tax asset); no amount stated in the notice
January 2026 grant to the chairman: 4,399,907 options, fair value ~NIS 5.4M (~NIS 1.8M per vesting year)
Prior-policy caps: chairman annual bonus up to 75% of base salary, CEO up to 125%; chairman equity at grant 101% of maximum annual base salary

verified_figures_from_secondary.chairman_tomer_raved: ~2.98M non-tradable options, fair value NIS 4M (Monte Carlo, external appraiser)
verified_figures_from_secondary.ceo_nir_david: ~4.46M non-tradable options, fair value NIS 6M (his first grant since taking office in 2024)
verified_figures_from_secondary.deviation: ~NIS 1M above the chairman's equity/variable-compensation cap for 2027; chairman's grant only
verified_figures_from_secondary.vesting: 3 equal annual tranches (Nov 2027/2028/2029), exercise prices NIS 7.11 and 7.82 with share-price targets NIS 8/9; share ~NIS 7.05
verified_figures_from_secondary.approval: Compensation committee and board approved; special meeting Dec 21, 2026; requires a majority of disinterested holders

claims.claim_text: Headline: בזק רוצה לחלק 10 מיליון שקל ליו"ר ולמנכ"ל
claims.verified_figure: Non-tradable options with a combined accounting fair value of ~NIS 10M (4M + 6M), vesting in three annual tranches over 2027-2029, with exercise prices (NIS 7.11 and 7.82) above the current share price (~NIS 7.05)
claims.note: The total is right, but the headline verb 'לחלק' reads like a cash payout. The NIS 10M is a Monte Carlo fair value of options spread over three vesting years, and their realized value depends on the share price. The lede does say 'אופציות', but the headline drops it.

claims.claim_text: Split: about NIS 4M of options to chairman Tomer Raved (the remainder, ~NIS 6M, to CEO Nir David)
claims.verified_figure: Chairman ~2.98M options = NIS 4M; CEO ~4.46M options = NIS 6M (Globes, Calcalist and Bizportal, citing the company's meeting notice)
claims.note: Three independent reports agree. The primary notice itself returned 403.

claims.claim_text: Headline: the grant is 'תוך חריגה מהמדיניות שנקבעה' (in deviation from the established policy)
claims.verified_figure: The only reported deviation is ~NIS 1M on the chairman's NIS 4M grant. No source reports the CEO's NIS 6M grant as exceeding the policy.
claims.note: The deviation is real: the board itself calls it a one-time deviation. The headline, however, attaches it to the whole NIS 10M package for both officers. TheMarker's own lede narrows it to about NIS 1M on the chairman's grant.

claims.claim_text: Raved's options (~NIS 4M) exceed the 2027 variable/equity compensation cap by about NIS 1M
claims.verified_figure: ~NIS 1M over the cap, per the board's own 'one-time deviation' wording as reported by Globes, Calcalist and Bizportal
claims.note: The absolute cap figure (implied ~NIS 3M) is not published in any reachable source. The policy's Appendix A and the Nov 13 notice were both blocked (403).

claims.claim_text: The policy being deviated from was approved by shareholders only early this year (January)
claims.verified_figure: Revised compensation policy put to the special general meeting of Jan 25, 2026, for a 3-year term
claims.note: Confirmed by the supplementary immediate report on MarketScreener. This also makes the headline's 'רק בינואר' framing factually grounded.

claims.claim_text: Each of the chairman and CEO may receive up to ~NIS 3M more if the Bezeq-yes structural separation is cancelled and other conditions are met
claims.verified_figure: The Jan 2026 policy confirms a one-time structural-separation bonus for the chairman and relevant CEOs, subject to three conditions. The amount is in Appendix A, which was not reachable.
claims.note: The bonus mechanism exists, but the ~NIS 3M figure could not be checked. Calcalist describes an earlier separation-bonus program as lapsed, so the current status needs the primary filing.
